title: Keyhole Arch Light Effect
content: Photographers wait all year for the conditions to be right to shoot this mystical light effect at Pfeiffer Beach, California.According to the Mail Online, "it occurs in the weeks surrounding winter solstice when the sun sets directly behind the arch. The tide must also be high enough for the light to reflect off its surface. The sky must also be clear on the horizon. Some photographers maintain it must be captured at a 35 degree angle for the perfect shot."Photo byMark Brodkin / Solent NewsCourtesyMail OnlineThanks,Rob Nonstop
